rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and notes ICM/TE/zona features, but some image-based claims are overconfident given the limited single focal plane; TE and blastocoel detail are not clearly visualized, and speculation about debris/apoptotic blebbing is not well supported.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, BMI, cycle history, sperm motility, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible prognosis estimate tied to case factors, though some quantitative adjustments and literature-style percentages are somewhat assertive beyond what the provided data alone can support.

Mostly aligned on SET and general prognosis, but includes less guideline-supported suggestions such as ERA after a single failure and adjuncts like sildenafil/pentoxifylline/vitamin E/aspirin for lining optimization, which are not routine evidence-based recommendations.
Provides clear practical steps for transfer and contingency planning, especially SET and follow-up considerations, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care.
